description:
Are you ready to own something big? Automox is turning IT admins into IT heroes by replacing traditional tools with our award winning cloud-native endpoint management platform. Our product works autonomously and so do our teams. We value a ‘one team’ mentality where everyone’s unique skills contribute to an environment that encourages collaboration and ownership. At Automox you’re enabled to do your best work, grow your career, and have an impact that will be noticeable. WE ARE A_TOMOX… all that’s missing is U! 

Our Customer Experience team doesn’t wait for the renewal conversation to prove value. We’re searching for a strategic, action-oriented Director of Customer Adoption & Digital Success who’s excited to build the programs that get every Automox customer to realize value at scale. You’ll own the lifecycle automation, customer education, in-product guidance and 1:many engagements that reach every customer, from small businesses to our largest enterprise accounts.

This is a strategic builder role reporting to the VP of Customer Experience. You’ll arrive with a point of view, experiment quickly, and improve with data. You’ll work closely with Account Management, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, Product and Marketing to turn adoption into stronger retention.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN & DRIVE

  • Define the adoption model for each customer segment, including what is automated, what is 1:many, and where human touch matters most.
  • Build and run lifecycle journeys at scale for onboarding, adoption milestones and pre-renewal sentiment using data-driven triggers for risk, low deployment and expansion.
  • Partner with Ops to enhance our customer success platform, health scoring, journey orchestration and dashboards.
  • Partner with Marketing to develop and execute customer campaigns that drive product adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion opportunities.
  • Lead the strategy for Automox University (our on-demand training platform for users), customer workshops and in-product guidance, partnering with Product and Growth to improve education directly in the product.
  • Lead the strategy for Automox’s knowledge management and AI-powered self-service support experience called Patch AI.
  • Own roadmap planning of customer engagements (webinars, office hours, campaigns and communication). 
  • Lead the pooled digital customer success motion for our digital customer segment.
  • Run the NPS program, routing voice of the customer themes to executive leadership.
  • Measure the effectiveness of customer engagement initiatives, continuously optimizing campaigns to improve adoption, customer health, and retention.
  • Lead and grow a team covering customer enablement, education and digital customer success.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

  • 8+ years in customer success, digital success or customer marketing at a B2B SaaS company, including 3+ years leading teams.
  • A track record of building a scaled or digital customer success program from an early stage, not only running an existing one.
  • Hands-on experience with a customer success platform (Gainsight, ChurnZero, Planhat, Vitally or similar) and journey automation.
  • Strong data skills: health scores, cohort analysis, and tying programs to gross and net dollar retention.
  • Experience partnering with Product on onboarding, in-app guidance or customer education.
  • Clear writing and the ability to turn a strategy into a plan with owners, dates and metrics.
  • A bias to action, driving impactful work forward quickly.
  • The ability to build strong partnerships with Sales, Marketing and Product.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with IT, security or infrastructure software sold to technical buyers.
  • Background with in-product guidance tools such as Chameleon, Pendo or Appcues, and customer education platforms.
  • Experience applying AI to customer engagement or self-service support.
  • A background in IT operations, endpoint management or security, such as patching and vulnerability response.

The range listed is the on target earning (OTE) potential. OTE is a mix of base pay and variable pay earned based on meeting sale's goals. In addition to OTE our compensation package includes equity and variety of great benefits. Actual earnings may be less or more depending on a candidate's direct experience, skills, industry knowledge, and location. Details of the OTE split will be shared during the interview process.

Sales OTE range
$195,000—$225,000 USD

LOCATION

We are a fully distributed company of remote employees.

***Note: We currently don't hire in California or New York metro***

ABOUT AUTOMOX

Automox is the cloud-native IT operations platform for modern organizations. Our award-winning answer to modern IT operations and best-in-class results earned Automox four straight quarters of record growth. We are now trusted by more than 2,500 leading companies and MSPs worldwide, including NASA, Yale, Xerox, Allbirds, and Unicef. It makes it easy to keep every endpoint automatically configured, patched, and secured – anywhere in the world. The future of IT Operations is cloud-native – and right now. Will you join us?

EMPLOYMENT AT AUTOMOX

✅ Must be able to pass a federal, state, county background check
✅ Complete a local in-person verification

TOTAL REWARDS: Thrive with Us

💵Competitive Salary
